--- pipe_aggregate_trailing_comma_before_rparen.sql
(
  FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x
  |> AGGREGATE COUNT(*) AS n,
)

  Query: &ast.SubQuery{
    Rparen: 56,
    Query:  &ast.Query{

          Source: &ast.Unnest{
            Unnest: 9,

            Expr:   &ast.ArrayLiteral{
              Array:  -1,
              Lbrack: 16,
              Rbrack: 18,
              Values: []ast.Expr{
                &ast.IntLiteral{
                  ValuePos: 17,
                  ValueEnd: 18,
                  Base:     10,
                  Value:    "1",
                },
              },
            },
            As: &ast.AsAlias{
              As:    21,
              Alias: &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 24,
                NameEnd: 25,
                Name:    "x",
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
      PipeOperators: []ast.PipeOperator{
        &ast.PipeAggregate{
          Pipe:  28,
          Items: []*ast.PipeAggregateItem{
            &ast.PipeAggregateItem{
              DirPos: -1,
              Expr:   &ast.CountStarExpr{
                Count:  41,
                Rparen: 48,

              As: &ast.AsAlias{
                As:    50,
                Alias: &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 53,
                  NameEnd: 54,
                  Name:    "n",
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
(FROM UNNEST([1]) AS x |> AGGREGATE COUNT(*) AS n)
